format.summary: Public contact facts used by the sentence bank (spoken forms) and the card (display forms). Phone numbers: E.164 in phone, (xxx) xxx-xxxx in display, digit groups in spoken.
format.hours: hours.weekly is machine-readable (America/Los_Angeles) for display and checks only; refriGator has no 'open now' logic (docs/SPEC.md, situation 9.2): hours.text and hours.spoken are always given with the number.
format.rule: Only numbers listed here may appear in the repo (besides 988, 911 and the demo number setting). Never invent hours: null means 'see the website'.
format.omitted: The county fax number and drop-box address from earlier drafts are left out: they are not on a page saved for this project. Students are pointed to BenefitsCal uploads and the county phone line instead.
